reuse.why: Extends the tree's single applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend definition with holidays and replaces every bare d.isWeekend check with the new shared isNonWorkingDay.

duplication.why: The non-working-day predicate and the shift loop are defined once; the pre-existing per-site daily-skip branches remain, each now with its own holidays-length look-ahead padding.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts; server code (schedules app, budget schedule-template, rule-utils) only forwards config.holidays.

scope.why: Only the weekend rule, its callers, the recur parser and the type change.

maintainability.why: Clear single definition of the rule; small costs are the repeated `holidays.length` padding heuristics at three sites and a garbled comment ('by by').

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend handling goes through applyWeekendRule or isNonWorkingDay, including both schedule-template calls.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the predicate is shared and the shift loop lives only in getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay and applyWeekendRule in shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts (upcoming dates, getDatesInRange) and budget/schedule-template.ts.
